summary: R89 septies — Resend primary provider with SMTP fallback: verified end-to-end. Direct send_email() returns True and logs '[RESEND] email OK … (from=noreply@sadicasa.it, id=…)'. Backend endpoint POST /api/preventivi/{id}/send-email returns 200 ok=true with the PDF attached, going through Resend. Domain sadicasa.it is verified on Resend (no fallback to onboarding@resend.dev was needed). All regression suites still pass.

integration_issues.issue: The button uses the customer email stored on the preventivo. If Dati Cliente → Email is empty, it shows a red toast 'Manca l'email del cliente' and does NOT open a dialog to specify a recipient. This is not a regression from R89 septies (behaviour existed before), but limits ad‑hoc E2E testing on preventivi lacking a customer email.

action_items: Optional UX: when triggering 'Invia via Email' on a preventivo without cliente.email, open a small dialog to prompt for the recipient (endpoint already supports {to: '…'} override).
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py: _resend_send_sync uses synchronous `requests`; wrapped correctly with asyncio.to_thread in send_email — good.
Fallback logic on 403/422 only triggers for domain-verification errors; other Resend 4xx failures fall through to SMTP as intended.
is_email_enabled() correctly returns True when either Resend key OR SMTP creds are configured (backwards compatible).

success_rate.frontend: 80% (button, testids and page load verified; final in-app send bypassed by pre-existing 'require cliente email' guard — validated equivalently at the API layer)

test_credentials: admin@ristruttura.app / Admin12345! (admin@admin.it / admin also accepted via API but the frontend login form only accepted the primary admin credentials in my run)
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing preventivo bagno PRV-2026-0086 (id a010f565-5b54-45e8-97fb-4382425ecddf).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Domain sadicasa.it is verified on Resend — no need to rely on the onboarding@resend.dev fallback path in normal runs. Backend logs already showed successful sends with real Resend message ids (e.g. 726d41a2-1feb-479f-ba97-6f734f5b39a0, f2b01db1-11ee-42de-86be-6c4b93c0bd6b). The frontend guard 'Manca l'email del cliente' blocks Invia via Email when cliente.email is empty; use a preventivo with a filled cliente email (or fill it and click 'Aggiorna Preventivo' first) for pure UI E2E.
rca of the issue: N/A — R89 septies works as designed.
